description: This Java class defines a Square object used for rendering a two-dimensional square in an OpenGL ES 1.0/1.1 context. It sets up vertex buffers, color, and draw order, and contains a method to execute drawing commands using the OpenGL API.

classes.name: Square
classes.description: Represents a drawable square in OpenGL ES with setup for buffers, color, and rendering logic.

methods.name: Square
methods.description: Constructor that initializes vertex and draw list buffers for the square.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Encapsulates OpenGL ES commands to render the square, using specified color and buffers.
